name: Financial Assistance To Dependent Children Of Widows And Destitute Women
benefit: ₹ 1000/- per month per child is provided for up to two children in a family to meet the cost of maintenance and education.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a widow/destitute woman or with a dependent child/children. OR the legal guardian of the child/children who have been deprived of parental support or care after their parent's death or continued absence from home. 1. The age of the child/children should be less than or equal to 18 years. 1. If parents of the child/children have died, the assistance will be provided to the legal guardian. 1. The widow/destitute woman or the legal guardian should be a resident of the UT of Chandigarh for more than 3 years. 1. The child should not be in receipt of family pension from any State/Central Govt.
**NOTE:** Children who have been given institutional care by government/NGO shall not be eligible for financial assistance.
